items.definition:
A type of pasta in the shape of small tubes

a dish made from oats boiled in water or milk

an outdoor fire in a camp, used for cooking or warmth
We sat around the campfire, telling stories and roasting marshmallows.

a machine for cutting grass
The lawn mower broke down.

a type of Italian cheese
I love pizza with extra mozzarella.

A person who delivers mail.
The postman delivered a letter to our door this morning.

A girl attending school.
The schoolgirl carried a heavy backpack full of books.

the flat top surface of a table

a display screen that responds to touch
My new phone has a very responsive touchscreen.

hello, goodbye, love (Hawaiian greeting)

a flat, rectangular case, typically made of leather, used for carrying documents

a place used for camping
We found a perfect campsite by the river.

a movable indicator on a computer screen
Move the cursor to the top left corner of the screen.

a portion of food or drink
This recipe makes four servings.

regular work done in cleaning and maintaining a house
She spends her mornings doing housework.

eating utensils, especially those made of or coated with silver
Please set the table with the silverware.

a pushchair or pram for a baby or young child

a root vegetable

disc jockey

a shop where medicines are sold
I need to go to the drugstore to pick up my prescription.

a device for controlling the flow of water from a pipe

A strap or harness designed to hold a person securely in a seat, especially in a car or aircraft.
Always wear your seatbelt when driving.

Tablespoon (a unit of measurement, or a large spoon).
Add 2 tbsp of sugar to the mixture.

a small earphone that fits inside the ear

a small van, typically for passengers

a shallow dish, typically with a slight indentation in the center, on which a cup stands.

a bell on the outside of a door that a visitor presses to alert the occupants

a large, flightless, fast-running Australian bird resembling an ostrich

a sweet, creamy glaze made of sugar, butter, and milk or water, used to cover or decorate cakes or cookies

the season of spring

an Australian marsupial

a starchy root vegetable

the yellow part of an egg

a cold drink made of milk, ice cream, and flavoring

an electronic game played on a screen

A large board with a smooth, dark surface, used for writing on with chalk.

a moving staircase

a breed of dog with a curly coat

a large, common seabird with long wings and typically white and grey plumage

knives, forks, and spoons used for eating

a purple vegetable, also known as aubergine

a spicy Italian sausage, often used on pizza

A deep cooking pan with a handle
She heated the soup in a small saucepan.

A board used for gliding over snow

Garments worn for swimming
Don't forget to pack your swimwear for the beach.

A layer of food placed on top of other food

a semi-liquid food made from fermented milk

a band of material worn around the head

a thick paste made from ground chickpeas and sesame seeds, olive oil, lemon, and garlic

a type of flatbread

grandfather (informal)

the sound made by a mobile phone when an incoming call is received

a vehicle on runners, used for traveling over snow or ice

a box for holding tools

a juicy, soft fruit, resembling a small peach

a device that fits into or over the ear, used for listening to audio

a type of baked snack
I bought a warm pretzel from the street vendor.

a person who teaches in a school
My mother was a schoolteacher for thirty years.

A piece of cloth or plastic fastened under a baby's chin to keep its clothes clean.
The baby wore a bib to protect its clothes from spills.
